name: character_factory_flow
description: Photo to animated character in three agent-driven card stages: lift (img-to-mesh pixal3d — textured mesh, repair knobs ON), rig (rig card auto — SOMA-77 weights), motion (motion card kimodo — text-to-motion skinned onto the rigged mesh, somax bake in-graph). WHAT it produces: an animated GLB (plus its motion NPZ) from one photo + one action line. HOW agents drive it: stages are AGENT-DRIVEN card chains through the queue door ({model:} per card, or the bench) — there is no single-shot yaml door; stages are driven one card at a time. Multi-stage: named registry flows DRIVE at start (the curated-lane lift; the refusal is hand-authored inline only). Creature motion is NOT a stage — it rides the MOTION phase (unimate dataset clip through the game-profile MCPs, rig copy bridge), documented in the leaf skill.

photo.description: Required. Source photo (EstatePhotoRef at the initial gate) — one clear subject, tight framing; background is removed automatically.

prompt.description: Required. What the body DOES — verb-first, one continuous action (kimodo text-to-motion). Same seed + prompt = same take.
